description:
Use it when a sender can produce email but the receiving workflow expects a webhook. The SMTP gateway accepts the message, authenticates and routes it through UnitySVC, converts the email subject and body into a compact `{title, body, type, format}` JSON payload, and forwards that summary to your HTTP receiver. If you need full raw email delivery with headers, attachments, and both body formats, use `smtp-to-http` instead.

Use the free `byok` channel to forward every message to one receiver stored in customer secrets (`SMTP_HTTP_RELAY_BASE_URL`, optional `SMTP_HTTP_RELAY_API_KEY`). Use the metered `plus` channel to route different mailbox enrollments to different receiver URLs; each enrollment binds its own `base_url`, uses a unique SMTP username, and is billed at $1 per 1,000 emails. See “How to use this service” for setup and examples.
name: smtp-to-msg

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own HTTP receiver

summary: Turn inbound email into compact HTTP notification payloads delivered to an endpoint you control.
